_README: Ten labelled pages for the W3 extractor.
These are SYNTHETIC pages, hand-written to reproduce the shapes that actually
broke the predecessor system. They are not copies of real sites and must not
be described as such. Their job is to let the extractor's own behaviour be
tested offline and deterministically: span checking, dropping unsupported
fields, thin-page restraint, off-domain route_url, past-cycle rejection.
Measuring FIELD ACCURACY of a real model is a different exercise and needs
real recorded pages plus a live call. That is scripts/eval_extraction.py,
run deliberately with `make eval-extraction` once fixtures are recorded.
`expect` records what a correct extraction says. `not_stated` means the page
does not say, and asserting that is the point on the thin pages: a thin page

pages.note: An open rolling call. The shape of the one Art actually submitted to.
pages.markdown:
# Apply to Speak

AI Week is accepting proposals from speakers, trainers and sponsors on a rolling basis. There is no deadline; sessions are reviewed monthly.

Tracks: manufacturing, healthcare, financial services, and workforce.

Formats: 45-minute workshop, 20-minute talk, panel.

Questions? Contact Zack Huhn, Program Director, at programs@example-aiweek.org.

pages.note: THE GSAE CASE. The form is on another host, in body text. Missing this is why Art could not find it by hand.
pages.markdown:
# Speaker Interest

The education committee sets themes in early October each year.

Members and non-members may express interest in speaking by completing our short form: https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/EXAMPLE1

We look for sessions that help association professionals run better organizations.

pages.note: A PAST event. The predecessor served exactly this page as a way in. There is no route here.

pages.markdown:
# Workforce Development

We work on site with Georgia manufacturers to build workforce capability. Our statewide lunch-and-learn series is delivered by our staff and by partner instructors.

We serve more than 1,200 manufacturers across the state.

Contact your regional manager to discuss a project.

expect._comment: No intake page is published. A null route_url is the correct answer and sends this to WORTH A LOOK with a question.

pages.markdown:
# Become an Approved Provider

The state customized-training program contracts with approved third-party providers to deliver training inside employer facilities.

Applications are reviewed quarterly. Apply at https://example-training.gov/provider-application

Providers must carry insurance and demonstrate three years of relevant delivery experience. Approval is granted by the Program Director.

expect.intake_criteria: insurance and three years of relevant delivery experience

pages.note: A council seat. Employers in the room, a role beyond a ticket.
pages.markdown:
# Councils and Committees

Our Manufacturing Council meets monthly and is open to member companies. Council members are plant managers, operations VPs and owners.

The Education Committee shapes the annual programming calendar.

To join a council, member companies should contact Dana Whitfield, Director of Member Programs.

pages.note: THE THIN PAGE. The acceptance criterion names this one: it must yield not_stated, not plausible invention.

# Shipbuilder wins $40 million Navy sustainment contract

Published August 14, 2026

Example Shipbuilding announced it has been awarded a $40 million Navy sustainment contract, and expects to add 200 production roles at its Mobile facility over the next eighteen months.

"Hiring and training at this pace is our central challenge," said the company's Chief Operating Officer.

pages.note: Pay to be in the room. A real route, correctly weak — not to be dressed up as a speaking slot.
